implemented: verification prepare/review/retry-preparation binds six distinct UUIDs and every original/plan/chart/tree/context version, digest, item and ordinal. Source changes refuse before verification RPC.
Preparation creates or checks an owner-only metadata journal before remote write. It binds exact input bytes, actor, server and all source versions; it contains no request text or capture payload.

Strict body decoding refuses duplicate/unknown/alias keys, malformed or excessive limits and unreviewed source IDs. Replies cannot authorize continuation and must bind capture/frozen chart/context and signed observation/index hashes.

Responses exceeding explicitly reviewed prepare call/byte limits refuse. Failed replies preserve the journal and never automatically repeat preparation. Historical review/private retry send no private text.
